This query runs in ensure_embeddable on every embed comments request and in TopicEmbed.import, making it a hot path. Adding a functional index (e.g. on lower(host)) in the new migration is a concrete, actionable review item; the behavior is correct, so this is a substantive non-bug performance/scale con
